title: Autonomous Warehouse Inventory Reconciliation
business: Large-scale logistics providers managing high-density automated storage and retrieval systems.
problem: Traditional robotic systems struggle with spatial ambiguity and multi-step tool orchestration when items are misplaced or stacked irregularly, leading to manual intervention costs.
solution: Gemini Robotics ER 2 Preview provides advanced video understanding and spatial reasoning, allowing robots to interpret complex physical environments and coordinate multi-step tasks to resolve inventory discrepancies autonomously.
steps: Integrate the gemini-robotics-er-2-preview endpoint into the robot's onboard perception stack.
Stream real-time video feeds from robot-mounted cameras to the model for spatial analysis.
Define high-level task goals such as identifying and re-organizing misplaced inventory items.
Execute multi-step tool orchestration commands generated by the model to manipulate objects.
Validate task completion through continuous visual feedback loops.
outcome: Increased operational autonomy in complex, dynamic warehouse environments with reduced reliance on human oversight for routine spatial problem-solving.
limitation: The model's reliance on high-fidelity video processing may introduce latency in decision-making; developers should monitor the inference time against the physical robot's control loop frequency to ensure safety.
